Logmind v3 is now available

Logmind has launched v3, a major platform update designed to help IT teams understand and act on operational data faster. The release introduces a redesigned Operations Overview, enhanced Insights, improved visualizations, the Modu AI assistant, and visual data-processing pipelines.
